Send to Google Drive™ Send to Microsoft OneDrive™ Email Download Print Article Preview : Alfredo Adame - 67 years old - is already negotiating the new reality show he will work on before the end of 2025. The controversial actor has no end in sight and after his time on La Casa de los Famosos All Stars, he is already planning to enter another project. Alfredo Adame will do a new reality show before the end of 2025.After leaving behind his career as an actor and host, Alfredo Adame focused on doing reality shows.Alfredo Adame went to Sergio Mayer's YouTube channel -59 years old- where he revealed that he is negotiating his new reality show. The host mentioned that after working in several of these shows, he has been offered several...
